description: This script parses Zephyr device tree data using a pickled EDT object, and generates an XML file with USB VIF policies, including handling of sink PDOs and device components.

methods.name: get_value_attribute
methods.description: Converts data to string if necessary and returns a dictionary with a VALUE key.

methods.name: get_vif_element_name
methods.description: Returns the XML element name with a prefix based on the provided name.

methods.name: get_root
methods.description: Creates and returns the root XML element for VIF policies.

methods.name: add_attributes_to_xml_element
methods.description: Adds attributes to an XML element.

methods.name: add_element_to_xml
methods.description: Creates and adds a new sub-element to an XML element with optional text and attributes.

methods.name: add_elements_to_xml
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to an XML element based on a provided dictionary.

methods.name: add_vif_spec_from_source_to_xml
methods.description: Copies specific VIF specification elements from a source XML to the target XML.

methods.name: is_simple_datatype
methods.description: Checks if a value is a simple data type (str, int, bool).

methods.name: get_pdo_type
methods.description: Extracts the PDO type from a PDO value.

methods.name: get_xml_bool_value
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to a string representation used in XML.

methods.name: parse_and_add_sink_pdo_to_xml
methods.description: Parses a sink PDO value, adds corresponding XML elements, and returns power in mW.

methods.name: parse_and_add_sink_pdos_to_xml
methods.description: Processes a list of sink PDOs, adds them to XML, and records maximum power.

methods.name: parse_and_add_component_to_xml
methods.description: Adds component details, including PD support and sink PDOs, to XML.

methods.name: get_source_xml_root
methods.description: Parses and returns the root of a source XML file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads EDT data, constructs XML, and writes output file.
